name: Our Story
description: The little things. The big feelings. A scrapbook of everything that makes you, you.

scenes.title: Some things just feel like home.
scenes.body: For the people who turn ordinary days into our favourite memories.

media.alt: Friends sharing a carefree afternoon outdoors

scenes.title: Nothing planned. Everything remembered.
scenes.body: The long walks. The terrible jokes. The coffee that went cold because we had too much to say.

media.alt: Sunlight reaching through a peaceful woodland

scenes.title: My favourite place is wherever we are.
scenes.body: Here’s to a thousand more ordinary days together.

scenes.title: Our next chapter starts here.
scenes.body: Same people. New adventures. All the love.

name: Your Special Day
description: A bright, joy-filled celebration of someone worth making a little fuss over.

scenes.title: The world is brighter with you in it.
scenes.body: A little celebration of your very wonderful existence.

media.alt: Colourful balloons ready for a celebration

scenes.title: You make the everyday feel like an occasion.
scenes.body: Your big heart. Your fearless laugh. That way you always show up.

scenes.title: More joy. More wonder. More you.
scenes.body: May this next chapter be filled with the things that make your eyes light up.

media.alt: A cake decorated for a special day

scenes.title: Here’s to your next beautiful year.
scenes.body: Go on. Take up space. Make a little magic.

name: Look How Far
description: An unfolding tribute to the steps, the courage, and the person you’re becoming.

scenes.title: Look at you. Look how far.
scenes.body: A story about showing up, starting again, and finding your own way.

media.alt: A mountain peak rising into the clouds

scenes.eyebrow: It started with a small yes
scenes.title: You didn’t have it all figured out.
scenes.body: You just took the next step. Then another. Somewhere along the way, the impossible became your everyday.

media.alt: A quiet mountain lake reflecting the landscape

scenes.title: The person you were would be so proud.
scenes.body: Not just of what you did. Of who you became while doing it.

scenes.eyebrow: And this is only the beginning
scenes.title: There’s a whole world ahead.
scenes.body: Take a breath. Enjoy this moment. The next chapter can wait.
